title: Field Service Engineer（US）
description:
1、Technical Troubleshooting and Remote Support: Provide technical troubleshooting support and remote repair guidance for escalated customer inquiries through various channels, including telephone support, video calls, real-time messaging, and tickets generated by the customer relationship management system, typically Zendesk
2、Complaint and Incident Management: Address escalated customer complaints and urgent incidents, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution of issues.
3、Documentation and Solution Development: Maintain documentation of product-related issues and develop corresponding technical solutions
4、Quality and Service Risk Identification: Identify potential quality or service issues during daily customer relationship management; take a proactive manner in reporting relevant issue and following up to ensure timely resolution. 5、Training and Reporting: Assess product post-market performance, prepare training materials for new colleagues to manage technical troubleshooting ticket data in the customer relationship management system, typically Zendesk, and regularly file related analysis reports.

1、Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or higher preferably in a science, technology, or engineering field. Candidates should be native English speakers, but those who demonstrate proficiency in Chinese (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) will have an additional advantage
2、Experience: At least 2 years of technical support service experience; familiar with customer service workflows.
3、Problem-Solving Skills: Driven by logical thinking and analytical thinking in identifying the root cause of issues
4、Proactive Approach: Proactively develop solutions to identified issues and effectively resolve them through communication and collaboration.
5、Service and Risk Management: Possess strong service awareness and the ability to identify potential service or quality risks.
6、Execution and Learning Ability: Strong execution skills, quick learner, and ability to summarize key information effectively.

title: Event Marketing Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Event Strategy & Planning
• Develop and own the U.S. event marketing strategy and calendar aligned with business objectives and product initiatives
• Plan and manage a diverse mix of events, including industry events, owned experiences, partner activations, and touring/mobile formats
• Define success metrics and track performance across lead generation, brand awareness, and business impact
• Conduct post-event analysis and continuously optimize strategy and ROI
• Manage event budgets to ensure efficient and effective allocation of resources

⸻

2. End-to-End Event Execution
• Lead full-cycle event execution, including venue sourcing, contract negotiation, booth design, logistics, and on-site coordination
• Serve as the on-site lead for key events, ensuring seamless execution and high-quality delivery
• Build and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and run-of-show documentation
• Manage external vendors, agencies, and contractors

⸻

3. Experience & Activation Design
• Design engaging, interactive event experiences that go beyond traditional formats
• Develop hands-on activations, live demonstrations, and immersive brand interactions
• Partner with internal teams to drive pre-event promotion and post-event engagement
• Identify opportunities to capture compelling content, customer stories, and user-generated content

⸻

4. Lead Generation & Sales Alignment
• Collaborate closely with sales and business development teams to drive high-quality lead generation
• Ensure effective lead capture, qualification, and handoff processes
• Support conversion by aligning event strategy with broader revenue goals

⸻

5. Partnership & Stakeholder Management
• Build and manage relationships with key partners, including retailers, community organizations, and industry groups
• Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product, and global teams to ensure alignment
• Identify and execute co-marketing and sponsorship opportunities

⸻

6. Community Building & Engagement
• Support the development of a strong and engaged user and creator community through events
• Drive participation, advocacy, and long-term engagement
• Help turn event interactions into ongoing relationships

⸻

7. Content & Amplification
• Work with content and PR teams to maximize the reach and impact of events
• Ensure events are leveraged for storytelling, social media, and brand building
• Contribute to the creation of scalable content assets from event activations

Qualifications

Must-Have
• 4+ years of experience in event marketing (B2C or B2B), preferably in tech, consumer products, or related industries
• Proven experience managing events of varying sizes and formats
• Strong project management and organizational skills with attention to detail
• Experience managing budgets and negotiating with vendors
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
• Willingness to travel up to 30%

⸻

Nice-to-Have
• Experience with mobile activations, roadshows, or touring event formats
• Background in creator, maker, or community-driven ecosystems
• Familiarity with content marketing and social media amplification
• Passion for hands-on experiences, creativity, or emerging technologies

⸻

Success in This Role Looks Like
• Consistently delivering high-quality, impactful events
• Driving measurable business outcomes through event programs
• Creating memorable brand experiences that resonate with audiences
• Building strong partnerships and community engagement
• Continuously improving efficiency, scalability, and ROI of events
